title: The Create functions of the primitive contacts in __all__ of mainSystemExtensions
author: Claude-JG
description: The six Create functions of #3342 (CreateSphereCylinderContact, CreateCylinderCylinderContact, CreateCylinderTriangleContact, CreateConeConeContact, CreateConeTriangleContact, CreateConvexConvexContact) are not in __all__ of exudyn.misc.mainSystemExtensions; tools/checkAll.py reports it. Decided: __all__ written by checkAll.py --write.
releaseNotes: The Create functions of the contacts between primitive shapes are listed in __all__ of exudyn.misc.mainSystemExtensions.
